who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), command/unitkey lane, round three; resolved round five
what: the std keying test missed compiler_builtins' four libm aarch64 files because it keyed every crate without its features (`feature = "arch"` gates `libm/src/math/arch/mod.rs:11`); the command gets them from cargo's resolution in blaze-units (`StdKey::features`, `load/plan/flags.rs:185`), which blaze-unitkey's test cannot call without a VFS of the library
cost: one coordinator job run and a round of a lane
cause: the test rebuilt each unit's cfg by hand from the target table and std's script only, not from the graph the command builds
whys: blaze-unitkey's std test predates the command's graph and has no way to ask it for a unit's cfg
feature resolution lives in blaze-units' query database, which needs a tree of the library to run
class: a test that mirrors a production input by hand instead of reading it from the code that makes it
prevention: built: `blaze_units::stdlib::cfg::{std_graph, std_cfg, unit_cfg}` is the one source; the command's graph calls `unit_cfg`/`std_cfg`, the test resolves std's graph with `std_graph` over the library's files and calls `std_cfg`, and both gather through `blaze_unitkey::gather::gather`
workaround: none left: the feature table, the script runner and the test's own gather are deleted
